title: The Legend Lives On 20 Euro Silver Coin Set Proof
descriptionPlain: In three great strides this series traverses the eventful life and peerless oeuvre of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. The three coins represent the three acts in Mozart’s life; a life that, through the timelessness of his music, continues long after his death. Entitled “Wolfgang”, the first coin is dedicated to Mozart’s boyhood as a wunderkind; “Amadeus”, the second coin, is dedicated to his short but prolific adult life, which established his genius; and the third coin, “Mozart”, focuses on his musical afterlife and the legend he became after his premature death. Complete with a superbly designed wooden presentation case that provides the perfect environment to store and protect all three coins, this set is a fitting tribute to the most famous composer of all time.
